verses.text: For the music director. To the tune "Do Not Destroy." A poem of David. You rulers, do you really speak what is right? Do you judge people fairly?
No, in your hearts you plan evil. Your hands spread violence over the earth.
Wicked people go wrong from the day they are born. From birth they wander off and tell lies.
Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a cobra that blocks its ears
so it cannot hear the music of the snake charmer, however skilful he is.
God, break the teeth in their mouths! LORD, tear out the fangs of these lions!
Let them disappear like water that drains away. When they shoot their arrows, let them be blunt.
Let them be like a slug that melts away as it moves, like a baby born dead that never sees the sun.
Before your cooking pots feel the heat of the burning thorns, God will sweep them away, green and burning alike.
Good people will be glad when they see the wicked punished. They will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
Then people will say, "There really is a reward for good people. There really is a God who judges the earth."
